projects.title: Flagd
projects.summary: A pixel-art minesweeper roguelite in C++20 and raylib, where the numbers show nearby monster power.
projects.description: Flagd turns minesweeper into a roguelite: every number shows the total power of the monsters around it. Runs span 3 acts with bosses on a Slay-the-Spire-style map. Boards change the rules with wrap-around edges, hex grids, fog and lying numbers. A no-guess solver keeps every board fair.
highlights: 3 acts with bosses and a Slay-the-Spire-style branching map
Board twists: wrap-around, hex, fog and liars
4 classes, 9 items and 19 relics, plus meta-progression
Unit tests with doctest; CMake + Ninja build via MSYS2 UCRT64
